calls.title: Sintra.ai & Growthbook
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the issuance of a two-week enterprise trial license to a client, allowing them to evaluate the software’s new features before committing to a purchase. James Shannon facilitated the trial despite the absence of the solutions engineer, ensuring the client could access features immediately via an emailed license key. The client, represented by Jurgis Petrauskas-Mittas, expressed the need to confirm the functionality and value of the enterprise features before making a financial commitment, particularly due to a significant price increase. Follow-up meetings were scheduled after June 5th to accommodate the client’s busy schedule, while transparent communication helped maintain a positive relationship despite the engineer’s unavailability.
calls.keywords: enterprise license, pricing evaluation, trial testing, product features, scheduling, solutions engineer
calls.action_items:
**James Shannon**
Provide Sintra.ai with an enterprise trial license to test the software, including pre-align requisite features (00:07)
Email the license key to Sintra.ai later on the same day (03:08)
Schedule a follow-up meeting with Sintra.ai after June 5th to review testing results and discuss next steps (02:58)

**Jurgis Petrauskas-Mittas**
Coordinate internally with leadership to evaluate the trial license features against current needs and pricing before making a final decision (01:36)
Confirm availability for the meeting sometime after June 5th to discuss evaluation outcomes (02:44)
